description.value: Browns Socialhouse Harvey is a full-service casual dining chain restaurant located in the Gateway Plaza development at Harvey and Burtch in Kelowna. The location features a year-round patio and outdoor bar with plenty of seating, making it a reasonable stop for cyclists passing through the Harvey Avenue corridor. It is part of the Browns Restaurant Group, with a broad menu, brunch service on weekends, and both dine-in and delivery/pickup options.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active Browns Socialhouse franchise at 1544 Harvey Avenue, Kelowna, BC, listed in the chain's official locations directory. The phone number (236) 420-2292 and address match OSM exactly. The navigation bar includes 'Order Delivery & Pickup,' confirming takeout is available, but no website content mentions bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible restaurant confirmed by the chain's own website and locations directory. Useful stop for touring cyclists on the Harvey Avenue corridor.
